Episode 208. The Vamel Union does its job (1)
November 7, 1803.
"Huh... This is Luche's gift prepared for Lord Murakan. Quite a rare item."
Rub, rub.

Murakan was lying on his side, scratching his back and speaking. Next to him was a pile of cookies baked by Latree, and a full basket of eaten strawberry pies. Murakan was reading a book of spring paintings that Luche had left with Tikan.
"Hmm, it's an original, not a copy. How did he get this while evacuating? Anyway, he's a remarkable kid. I like him very much."
"Murakan, are you goofing off again?"
"What do you mean goofing off, Quikantel. There's nothing to do."
"Everyone else is busy."
"What am I good at? Fighting. But there's no fight right now, no fight. You think I'm playing because I want to, huh?"
"Well, that's true."
The enemy race continued to invade only the Lute Magic Federation. The struggle between the two powers was named the Anti-Magic War.

Despite Elona being released from the seal, Zipfel was not gaining the upper hand. Rather, they were struggling with a more meticulously continuing invasion. It was because they did not have the space movement technology like the Vamel Union.
Of course, it wasn't that Elona's appearance had no meaning.

If they couldn't locate Elona and mistakenly struck the area where she was waiting, or miscalculated the time she would arrive on the battlefield, the enemy race that encountered her were without exception, annihilated.
Fortunately for the enemy race, no air fortress or a figure equivalent to a Great Battle King had yet encountered Elona. They had already categorized Elona as a being beyond the Blue Race Avatar.
There was a sound in the corridor. Murakan recognized it as Jin and Gilly's footsteps and quickly hid the book of spring paintings and cookies out of sight.
"Oh, you're here, kid. And my strawberry pie. I was meditating. As you know, kid, when your power reaches this level, it takes quite a bit of time just to organize it."
"Wipe the cream on your mouth before you speak. It's obvious you were playing."
"It can all be considered part of management."
"I guess so. Let's go, we're going to the Sword Emperor Ground."
"Sword Emperor Ground? Got it. We're taking the strawberry pie with us, right?"
"Gilly needs to rest since she has a lot of work to do unlike you. If you want to play with Gilly, you need to do something too."
"What's that cold remark? Are you saying I can only have a date with strawberry pie if I do something?"
"Isn't the nuance of a date and playing a bit different?"
"Strawberry Pie, do you agree?"
"Hmm, rather than looking at the spring painting book here..."
"Hehe, got it. Then I'll immediately do something meaningful and come back. Let's go, kid!"
Murakan said as he stepped outside following Jin. Gilly chuckled at their backs.
"Wheeek. Ugh, even after regaining my old strength, I just can't adapt to this."
As soon as the space leap of the Red Owl ended, Murakan vomited again.
"We have to go around today, what now?"
"Ugh… If it's to play with Strawberry Pie, I can endure this much."
"Jin, you're here? Lord Murakan too."
"Brother Jin, and the great Black Dragon Murakan!"
Valeria and Luche greeted the two.
"Oh, Luche. I received your gift well. It's a piece that's good enough to be included in my collection. If you have any requests, let me know!"
"Actually, there were parts in the construction site that need to be carved out largely. Please solve it with Lord Murakan's great power! It takes time with only the knights and magicians here."
"An act meaningful enough for Strawberry Pie to acknowledge. Good, let's go!"
Murakan immediately followed Luche into the construction site.
"Where's Dr. Quawl?"

"Lately, he's been entrusting most of the construction to Luche and focusing on research. He's in the lab with Honka in a sensitive state, so it's better not to visit. He's almost going crazy. If someone other than me enters, he'd cause a scene."
The magical creature, the toad Honka, has been with Mariette Hister the longest in the past. This means Honka has been observing Mariette creating Elero for the longest time.

Thanks to this, Honka's memory was greatly helpful in producing the mass-production type Elero. Although Honka didn't actually understand Mariette's work, Quawl inferred based on what Honka had seen and heard.
"I see."

The growth of the Vamel Union could not be overstated as it was dependent on Quawl's research. Distribution of communication devices, development of mass-produced Eleros, Golden Fleet, Project Return of Lafrarosa, mass production of Red Owls, etc. Aside from the paper production that the Wantaramo Forest is progressing, it's all Quawl's work to accomplish.

Furthermore, Giple and the Red Demon Tribe are unable to contain the alliance due to waging war, and since the status of Orgal and Zephyrin hasn't improved yet, now was the optimal time to focus on research.
Especially, the immediate tasks were communication device and Iello mass production. Right now, it's a Red Demon War, but no one knows when it will turn into a world war.
More than anything, the Red Demon Tribe isn't the only problem.
The Bongmabyeok that Ameris is guarding.

The moment it collapses, the demons remaining in the underground world will start to act. And they had no good feelings towards the surface world. After the world was split in two, the demons were forced to be trapped underground.
Most of the demons' goals were the resurrection of the Sun God or surface occupation.

-[The entrance to the underground world is here only. But someone has been pulling the denizens of the underground to the surface without my knowledge… that’s very detestable. I should find out what tricks they played and punish them. How many demons has he brought up?]
-I can't be sure, but I guess it wouldn't exceed ten thousand. But, we expect there are less than ten demons that could actually pose a threat.
-[So, they are just gathering dust. Did the
y steal it bit by bit like a petty thief without my noticing? Using the steel dimensional gate ability you mentioned.]
According to Ameris, the demons that Orgal manages are 'dust' compared to the total.
Moreover, they would have ancient technologies like the Red Demon Tribe, so they could be formidable opponents for the current Vamel Union.
'Of course, it would be best if the Bongmabyeok isn't broken… the seal of Elona also fell at an utterly unexpected moment.'
The Bongmabyeok, and the Demon King Zito sealed in the holy country.
Jin had an intuition that they might be unsealed suddenly like Elona. The Vamel Union and Inse had to be able to maintain their position firmly even after all those risk factors appeared.

Murakan's return alone is not enough. Giple, who is still waging a faltering war with the Red Demon Tribe despite having Elona, proved that. It had to be the power of the faction itself, not the power of an individual, that was overwhelmingly strong.

"I'll let you know about the progress instead. The communication device will soon be produced in bulk and distributed to each base. We also have a prototype for the portable communication device, but it needs to be improved as it's not enough to use in reality.”
"It's encouraging that the prototype is already out. Jin, it's much faster than Teben predicted."
"The mass-produced Iello isn't a prototype, but it seems that thanks to Honka, Qwaul is finding clues one by one. As I promised to Iello, the finished product will be out within a year."
"A year, the Red Demon War won't end within that period. If there are no problems with the Bongmabyeok and Zito, we have enough time."
"And the Golden Fleet... well, we had some results from analyzing the Red Demon Tribe items we recently obtained. But there is a fundamental problem. You know, right?"
"I heard we need a large amount of light cores."

"That's right. We need to convert light cores, or something equivalent to them, into a power source. To get that much of light cores, we need to complete the return project to Lafrarosa, or we need to get them from the Red-Name Tribe. The former is uncertain when it will be completed, and the latter has a very high chance of not being suitable. After all, the design of the Golden Fleet was based on the light cores of the Nameless Tribe, not the Red-Name Tribe."
"We're not in a situation where we can take light cores from the Red-Name Tribe. To do that, we'd have to participate in the war. It also feels wrong to use the light cores of the Red-Name Tribe."
"Even if we had a light core now, turning it into a power source is another problem. It's not a field that can be solved technically. At least not based on what we know so far."
"If it's not technology, do we need divine power?"
"Perhaps. The lost parts of the Golden Fleet design given by your brother Boras. Those probably have something to do with it."
At this point, it is impossible to find the lost designs. Those parts were missing even before the current Nameless Tribe was trapped in Lafrarosa.

"Therefore, unless my recording magic becomes more powerful or we obtain some groundbreaking means, the Golden Fleet cannot be completed. Of course, it's possible to create a fleet comparable to the Golden Fleet if we have enough time."
To enhance the recording magic, a transmission land must be found, but Valeria had not been able to find another transmission land after Maliet.

'My previous life's Valeria seemed to have found most of the transmission lands when I was twenty-seven or twenty-eight. Many things have changed due to me in this life, so it might happen earlier... But there are too many worrisome factors to just wait.'

Moreover, even if the recording magic becomes more powerful, there is no guarantee that the lost design can be found, and even if it is found, there is no guarantee that the method can be implemented in the current situation.
Therefore, Valeria and Quale were focusing on a 'groundbreaking discovery'. They said they have to find the way by contemplating it.
"Indeed... The return project to Lafrarosa and the production of the Golden Fleet are the biggest problems."
"That's right, we're doing all sorts of experiments because of those two things. But yesterday, the doctor and I came up with an idea."
"What kind of idea?"
"Kaltor."
"Kaltor?"
The guardian dragon of Julian, Kaltor.
After being rescued by Jin from Joshua's villa in the past, he consumed part of Ozdok's traitor, but he still hadn't regained consciousness. He had no choice, as his heart was completely shattered.
However, with Julian's dedicated nursing and the efforts of his comrades, he has recently shown signs of waking up little by little.

"That's right, the brain dragon Kaltor. If he wakes up, I'm going to try to communicate with the storm god Peitel. Peitel's power is brain energy, and fundamentally, he should have divine power as a god. I think it might be the answer."
